title: Rank Maze
answer: Press B to enter the alignment-specific rank maze. Reachable nodes form branching routes rather than mutually exclusive classes, and attunement chooses an earned title. Innate powers receive authored level-specific reach, duration, strength, destruction and transformations; spells and crystals never inherit rank, while artifacts use only explicit artifact/apotheosis rules. Two nearby aligned players who release the same innate power within two seconds form a Radiant or Umbral Concord: both regain energy and gain a finite shield while an opposed-faction shock pulse erupts. Each pair has a ten-second safety cooldown.
